raw_response: {"diagnosis": "After the 2026-01-15 CRM migration, 60 customers carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names, so these codes leak into silver_customers and gold_region_daily. raw_region_map is a complete 1:1 lookup for all four codes, so the fix is to translate the codes to region names in silver_customers.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.9, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(COALESCE(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = trim(m.region_code)"}}
